Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HiddenZombieFix_t: Draws zombies standing where you can see them that the game leaves undrawn, and lets them see you. Needs PZ Tools installed. Stands aside when Zombie Visibility Fix is on. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CreditMultiplier_: Multiplies the credits every delivery is worth.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_TrustThresholdMul: Multiplies the trust each stage and milestone needs. Lower is faster.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BonusMultiplier_t: Multiplies the credit bonuses for new item kinds, fully searched buildings and kill milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_RequestBonus_tool: Extra value, in percent, for items on this week's request list. Trust rewards raise it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterArrival: Fewest hours from a call to the helicopter's arrival. Trust rewards shorten it.
Most hours from a call to the helicopter's arrival.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CallInterval_tool: Days from one helicopter call until the next is possible. Trust rewards shorten it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterNoiseRa: How far, in tiles, the drop's helicopter is heard by zombies. 0: silent.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BoxReissueCost_to: Credits for a new delivery box. Short credits become debt.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionDeadline_t: Days to seal a mission's item into a delivery box.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionInterval_t: Days after a mission ends or expires until the next one comes.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShopPriceMultipli: Multiplies the shop's prices (not the upgrade serums).
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_KitsForSale_toolt: Bag capacity, bag weight, trunk and engine kits reach the shop at the first milestone. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumInterval: Days after buying cure serum before it can be bought again. Trust rewards shorten it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumShelfLif: Days from receipt until a cure serum no longer works.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_DelayDrugInterval: Days after buying the delay drug before it can be bought again. Trust rewards shorten it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_DelayDrugHours_to: Hours one dose slows the infection.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumPrice: Credits for a tree's first upgrade serum.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumGrowt: Each serum of a tree costs this much times the one before (up to the 26th).
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeEffectMult: Multiplies the size of upgrade effects that are numbers.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_SharedSerumMilest: After the top stage, a shared upgrade serum comes every this many trust milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShredDecay_toolti: How many recent shreds of one kind halve its yield. Lower makes repeats yield less sooner.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MeteorSites_toolt: Multiplies the number of meteor drop sites (24 by default).
